info.name: Athar Flutter API - New Project
info.description: Flutter-friendly API collection for a clean Athar backend. Includes proposed Sanctum auth endpoints plus storefront, cart, checkout, orders, and admin dashboard endpoints.

request.description: Proposed endpoint for Flutter account creation. Should return user and token.
Proposed Sanctum token login for Flutter. Current project only has web /login, so add this in the new project.
Return authenticated user.
Delete the current Sanctum token.
Home data: sliders, banners, categories, products, features, reviews.

item.name: Designs
item.description: Design editor endpoints. Templates and stickers are shared for all users; saved designs are scoped to the authenticated user.

request.description: Shared product/base design templates for the design screen.
Shared sticker catalog visible to all users.
Authenticated user's saved designs.
Save the designer state before adding to cart. Flutter should use data.id as the custom cart item design_id.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: Authenticated user wishlist/favorites endpoints. Uses the Sanctum bearer token and the authenticated user id from middleware.

request.description: Fetch the authenticated user favorite products with id, product_id, name, price, image, and in_stock.
Add a product to the authenticated user wishlist. Repeating this request returns success without creating a duplicate.
Remove a product from the authenticated user wishlist by product id.

request.description: Add a saved designer product to the authenticated database cart. Custom design cart items require either design_id or design_data; the cart keeps its own design_data snapshot.

request.description: Update quantity, color, or size for one authenticated user cart item.
Remove one authenticated user cart item.
Clear the authenticated user database cart.

item.name: Promo Codes
item.description: Mobile promo code endpoints. Validate can be used with a client subtotal; Apply uses the authenticated database cart and returns checkout-ready totals.

request.description: Validate a promo code against a supplied subtotal without consuming usage.
Apply a promo code to the authenticated Flutter cart. Returns subtotal, discount, delivery_fee, and total; it does not increment uses_count until order creation.

request.description: Create an order from the authenticated database cart, optionally apply promo_code, preserve custom design item data, increment promo usage, and clear the cart.
